metadata.description: Example feature requirements file covering multiple application types (web, mobile, API, data, automation). Features should start as failing and only the 'passes' field should ever be updated by tools or tests. Never remove or edit tests once created.

features.description: Marketing site landing page accessible at root path
steps: Open a browser and navigate to '/'
Verify a marketing style landing page is rendered
Confirm there is a primary headline describing the product or service
Verify there is a clear primary call-to-action button (e.g. 'Get started')
Check that the page returns HTTP 200

features.description: Documentation page accessible from main navigation
steps: Navigate to the landing page
Locate and click the 'Docs' or 'Documentation' link in the header or footer
Verify the URL changes to '/docs' or similar documentation path
Confirm a documentation layout renders with a sidebar of topics
Verify at least one documentation article is visible and readable

features.description: Contact page available with working contact form
steps: From the landing page, click on the 'Contact' or 'Support' navigation item
Verify the contact page renders with a form containing name, email, and message fields
Fill in the form with valid sample data
Submit the form and verify a success message is displayed
Confirm no client-side validation errors are shown for valid input

features.description: User can sign up with email and password
steps: Navigate to the sign up page (e.g. '/signup')
Enter a valid email address not previously registered
Enter a password that meets the documented password policy
Submit the form and verify an account is created
Confirm the user is redirected to an authenticated area or sees a success state

features.description: User can log in with existing credentials
steps: Ensure a user account exists with known email and password
Navigate to the login page (e.g. '/login')
Enter the valid credentials and submit
Verify login succeeds and a session or token is created
Confirm authenticated-only navigation items (e.g. 'Dashboard') are now visible

features.description: User can authenticate via external provider (e.g. Google OAuth)
steps: Navigate to the login page
Click the 'Continue with Google' button
Complete the external provider authentication flow using a test account
Verify the application receives a valid user profile from the provider
Confirm the user is logged in and an internal account is associated with the provider identity

features.description: Password reset flow functions end to end
steps: Navigate to the login page
Click the 'Forgot password' link
Enter the email address of an existing user
Verify a password reset email is sent to the user inbox in a test environment
Open the reset link, set a new password, and confirm login works with the new password only

features.description: User can add a physical product to the cart
steps: Navigate to the product catalog page (e.g. '/products')
Select a product and navigate to its detail page
Click the 'Add to cart' button
Verify the cart icon or cart page reflects the updated item count
Open the cart page and confirm the selected product appears with correct price and quantity

features.description: User can complete a simple checkout with test payment
steps: Ensure the cart contains at least one item
Navigate to the checkout page
Fill in shipping details with valid sample data
Use a documented test card number to simulate payment
Verify a confirmation page is displayed and an order record is created

features.description: Logged in user can view order history
steps: Log in as a user who previously completed at least one order
Navigate to the account or profile page
Click on the 'Orders' or 'Order history' section
Verify a list of past orders is displayed
Confirm each order entry includes status, total, and date

features.description: Content editor can create a new blog post in an admin interface
steps: Log in as a user with content editor permissions
Navigate to the admin content area (e.g. '/admin/posts')
Click the 'New post' button
Fill in the title, slug, and body fields with sample data
Save the post and verify it appears in the public blog listing

features.description: Content editor can schedule a post for future publication
steps: Log in as a content editor
Create a new post or edit an existing draft
Set a publish date in the future using a date/time picker
Save the post and confirm its status indicates 'scheduled'
Verify that the post does not appear publicly until the scheduled time has passed in a test environment

features.description: Public health check endpoint returns successful status
steps: Send an HTTP GET request to '/health' or the configured health endpoint
Verify the response status code is 200
Confirm the response body contains a recognizable 'ok' or equivalent status field
Check that the response time is less than 500ms under normal conditions

features.description: Authenticated API endpoint requires valid token
steps: Send an HTTP GET request to a protected endpoint without credentials
Verify the response status code is 401 or 403
Send the same request with an expired or invalid token
Confirm the request is rejected with an authentication error
Send the request with a valid token and verify a 200 response with expected data

features.description: Rate limiting is applied per API key
steps: Obtain a valid API key for testing
Send a burst of requests that stays under the documented rate limit and confirm all succeed
Send requests exceeding the documented limit within the specified time window
Verify responses begin returning a 429 status code for rate limiting
Confirm the limit resets after the documented cooldown period

features.description: Nightly ETL job loads data from source storage into data warehouse
steps: Trigger the ETL job manually in a non production environment
Verify the job picks up source files from the configured input location
Confirm the job completes without errors
Check that new rows appear in the target warehouse table for the expected date range
Validate a small sample of transformed records against raw input data

features.description: Business dashboard displays aggregated metrics from warehouse
steps: Navigate to the analytics dashboard URL
Verify at least one chart or KPI tile renders successfully
Confirm the displayed values match the latest data in the warehouse for a known date range
Interact with a date filter and verify the visuals update accordingly
Check that no JavaScript errors occur during interactions

features.description: Mobile app displays splash screen and transitions to home screen
steps: Install the mobile application on a supported test device or emulator
Launch the app and verify a splash screen appears
Confirm the splash screen shows the app logo or branding
Validate that the app transitions automatically to the main home screen within a reasonable time
Check that the transition does not freeze or crash

features.description: Mobile app supports offline read only mode for cached data
steps: Open the app while connected to the network and navigate to a list of items (e.g. articles or records)
Close the app and disable network connectivity on the device
Reopen the app and navigate back to the same section
Verify that previously loaded items are still visible from local cache
Confirm that new data is not requested until connectivity is restored

features.description: Primary navigation supports keyboard only interaction
steps: Open the web application in a browser
Use the Tab key to move focus through the primary navigation items
Verify visible focus indicators are present on each interactive element
Activate navigation links using Enter or Space keys
Confirm that navigation works without requiring a mouse

features.description: Core pages meet basic color contrast requirements
steps: Navigate to the main landing page, dashboard, and a detail page
Use an automated contrast checker on primary text and background combinations
Verify that body text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast ratios
Confirm that error messages and alerts are clearly legible
Document any components that fail contrast checks for remediation

features.description: Session is invalidated after user logs out
steps: Log in as a valid user
Verify that a session cookie or token is present
Click the 'Log out' control in the UI
Confirm the user is redirected to a public page
Attempt to access an authenticated endpoint with the old session and verify access is denied

features.description: Role based access control for admin features
steps: Log in as a standard user without admin rights
Attempt to navigate directly to an admin URL (e.g. '/admin')
Verify access is denied and a suitable error or redirect is shown
Log in as a user with admin role
Confirm the admin interface is accessible and functional

features.description: Continuous integration pipeline runs on every push to main branch
steps: Commit a small change to the main branch in a test repository
Push the commit to the remote repository
Verify that a CI pipeline is triggered automatically
Confirm the pipeline executes build, test, and static analysis stages
Ensure the pipeline status is reported back to the repository hosting service

features.description: Deployment pipeline can deploy latest main build to staging environment
steps: Ensure CI pipeline has produced a successful build artifact for the main branch
Trigger the staging deployment pipeline manually or via tag
Verify deployment completes without errors
Confirm the staging URL serves the new application version
Check that key smoke tests (health check, login, primary workflow) pass in staging

features.description: Support chatbot answers basic greeting message
steps: Open the web or in app chat widget
Type a simple greeting such as 'Hi' or 'Hello'
Send the message to the chatbot
Verify the chatbot returns a friendly response within a few seconds
Confirm no error messages are visible in the chat transcript

features.description: Weekly summary email is generated and queued
steps: Trigger the weekly summary job manually in a non production environment
Verify the job completes without errors in logs
Check that summary email messages are created and enqueued in the mail system
Inspect one example email and confirm it includes the expected metrics and content
Ensure emails are only sent to intended test recipients in lower environments
